description: This is a ViewModel class for managing the state of a list of notes in an Android application. It handles note querying, synchronization status, and manual sync actions, exposing a flow-based UI state.

classes.name: NotesListUiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state of the notes list, including query string, list of notes, and sync status.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel responsible for managing the notes list UI, including note retrieval, sync status, and user actions such as manual sync.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the query string used for filtering notes.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Initiates a manual synchronization of notes, both by enqueuing a background job and attempting immediate sync.
